test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ‘A’ is 3 times as good a workman as 'B’ and therefore is able to complete a job in 36 days less than ‘B’. In how many days will they finish 40% of the work, working together?
solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 3 : 1

Time difference to be taken by A and B = 36 days

**Concepts used:**

Time = 1/Efficiency

Total Work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 3 : 1

⇒ Ratio of time taken by A and B = 1 : 3

Let the time taken by A and B be y and 3y. 

As per the question, 

Time difference by B and A = 36 days 

3y - y = 36

⇒ 2y = 36 

⇒ y = 18 days 

Now, B can complete the whole work in = 3y = 54 days 

A can complete the whole work in = 18 days 

Total work done by A = 3 × 18 = 54 units

⇒ 40% of the work = 54 × 40/100 = 108/5

∴ Time taken by A and B to do 40% of the work together = (108/5)/(3 + 1)

**⇒ 5(2)/(5) days **
